Fix playing media URLs on new station firmware (#797, #800)

Station firmware built since ~2026-07-17 ignores the parameters of the
legacy `radio_play` directive: the station never requests the streamUrl
and starts a random Yandex radio station instead. Reported for Мини 2,
Мини 3, Лайт, Миди, Станция 2 - so `media_player.play_media`, Browse
Media and Music Assistant are broken on all updated devices.

Play media through `audio_play` instead - the directive Yandex cloud
itself sends to the station for music (captured from a vinsResponse of
a voice request). Stations advertise support for it as `audio_client`
in `supported_features` of every local message, so the legacy directive
is kept as a fallback for devices without it.

Verified on Станция Миди (2023), firmware 0.359.1.3.4389602532:

- `stream.format` is required, an unknown value makes the station drop
  the directive without a single request to the URL;
- the codec is detected from the content, so MP3 works for aac/flac/wav
  files as well, and HLS is only needed for playlists;
- metadata title/subtitle/art_image_url are reported back in playerState;
- switching to another URL while playing works without an explicit stop.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

Enable lock platform for cars and fix lock action type

The `lock.py` platform (YandexLock) exists but was never registered in
PLATFORMS, so `devices.capabilities.lock` was only exposed as a read-only
binary_sensor and never as a controllable lock entity.

Additionally, `device_action("lock", ...)` sent the wrong capability type:
`IOT_TYPES` had no "lock" key, so it fell back to
`devices.capabilities.custom.button` and the Yandex IoT API rejected the
request with HTTP 400.

Fixes:
- add "lock" to PLATFORMS in __init__.py
- add "lock": "devices.capabilities.lock" to IOT_TYPES in core/yandex_quasar.py

Tested on a devices.types.remote_car (GWM Tank 300): the lock entity now
appears and unlock (set value "open") is accepted by the API.
